title: How Lao Gan Ma, China’s iconic chilli brand, got caught in an AI storm
text:
How Lao Gan Ma, China’s iconic chilli brand, got caught in an AI storm | South China Morning Post Tech Trends - Tech Trends How Lao Gan Ma, China’s iconic chilli brand, got caught in an AI storm 1 Advertisement Artificial intelligence Tech Tech Trends How Lao Gan Ma, China’s iconic chilli brand, got caught in an AI storm 
 Viral claims of AI-driven job cuts at the Guizhou-based firm have brought anxieties about automation into sharp focus
 2 -MIN READ 2 -MIN 1 Listen Chong Ming Lee Published: 4:00pm, 28 Oct 2026 Updated: 9:33pm, 28 Oct 2026 For three decades, Lao Gan Ma’s glass jars, bearing the stern portrait of founder Tao Huabi, have been a fixture on Chinese dinner tables and a symbol of traditional food manufacturing. This week, however, the iconic chilli sauce has become an unlikely focus of public anxiety over artificial intelligence.
 Online rumours that the Guizhou-based company had replaced hundreds of factory workers with AI went viral, prompting boycott threats and highlighting growing public unease over the impact of automation on jobs in the world’s second-largest economy.
 Speculation mounted on the social media platform Weibo on Monday after claims spread that Lao Gan Ma had reduced its chilli-sorting workforce from more than 600 people to just 48 after installing an AI-powered inspection system.
